step3.title: Before you begin
step3.subtitle: Three promises Sahayak keeps.
step3.onDevice: Everything you enter — drafts, scenarios, saved sections — stays on this device, in your browser's own storage.
step3.noAccounts: No account, no sign-in, no server. There is nothing to lose access to.
step3.noAnalytics: No analytics — nothing about how you use this app is collected. One exception: this app can run fully offline, so before now it made no request on its own; now, while online, at most once a day, it asks whether newer reference data exists, which lets the server see only that a device opened the app that day. Turn this off in Settings, beside the manual "Check for data updates" button.
step3.finishError: Could not save your post and city — check your device's storage and try again, or use "Skip setup" above to continue without them.

consent.title: Before you turn on AI
consent.intro: Sahayak works fully without AI. Turning it on changes what leaves this device, so read this first.
consent.classified: Never enter official, sensitive or classified content, departmental file numbers, or anything that identifies a person. Nothing in this app can undo that once it has been sent.
consent.storage: A key you enter is encrypted with AES-GCM and stored only in this browser. It is sent nowhere except to Anthropic, as your own credential. Code running on this page could still read it — encryption at rest is not protection against that.
consent.cost: Sahayak is free and takes no payment. With your own key, Anthropic bills you directly for every request. You set a monthly token limit here and the app stops at it.
consent.accept: I have read this — enable AI

local.name: On this device
local.leaves: Nothing you type leaves the device. The model itself is downloaded once, from its public host, before you first use it.
local.cost: Free. The one-time download is 0.9–2.5 GB depending on the model you pick.

byok.name: Your own Anthropic key

openai.cost: Whatever that service charges you. Several have free tiers — and a free tier is often free because the provider may use what passes through it. Ollama on this machine sends nothing over a network at all.

local.cancelNote: Cancelling stops the wait, not a transfer already in flight. Whatever has arrived is kept, and downloading again continues from there.

openai.heading: Another AI service
openai.intro: Any service that speaks the OpenAI chat format works here. Enter its address and the model name exactly as that service spells them.
openai.free: Free options exist: Google AI Studio, Groq, several models on OpenRouter, and Ollama running on this machine. Sahayak takes no cut and sees no bill either way.
openai.baseUrlHint: The base address, without /chat/completions — for example https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1.
openai.baseUrlInvalid: That is not an address this app can use.
openai.insecure: This address is not encrypted and is not on this machine. Anything sent to it can be read in transit.
openai.localOnly: This address is on this machine, so nothing leaves it.
openai.modelHint: Exactly as that service names it — this app never rewrites it.
openai.keyHint: Stored encrypted in this browser and sent only to the address above. Leave it empty for a service that needs none, such as Ollama.
openai.supportsToolsHint: Turn this on only if the service documents it. Sahayak cannot test for it: a service that ignores the field and one that honours it answer the same way.
openai.supportsJsonHint: Asks the service to reply in JSON. Used when tool calling is not available.

note.tools: This service will be asked to call the app’s tools directly.
note.jsonFallback: This service does not do tool calling, so the app will fetch what it needs first and ask for a JSON reply. Answers stay grounded; they are just gathered differently.
note.textOnly: This service does neither tool calling nor JSON replies, so answers may be less reliably structured. Turn on whichever the service documents.

settings.title: Trainer settings

reviewQueue.bulkApproveHint: The critic approved these and, where there was something to check blindly, the blind check matched.

tts.title: Read aloud
tts.onDevice: Spoken by this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.

noVoice.none-at-all: This browser has no speech voices installed, so read aloud cannot run here.
noVoice.remote-only: The only voices this browser offers for this language are synthesised on a server. This app will not send the text of a provision to one, so read aloud is unavailable until a voice that runs on this device is installed.
noVoice.none-for-language: No voice for this language is installed on this device.

hint.android: On Android: Settings → System → Languages & input → Text-to-speech output → install the voice data for this language.
hint.windows: On Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech → Manage voices → Add voices.
hint.macos: On macOS: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices.
hint.ios: On iOS: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices.
hint.other: Install a text-to-speech voice for this language through your operating system's settings.

polish.timeLeft: about {{count}} min left in this chapter

compare.title: Compare two units
compare.subtitle: Side by side, with the wording that differs marked. Useful for a provision and the one that replaced it, and for the same rule in two rule books.
compare.empty: Pick a unit on each side to compare them.
compare.identical: These two are word for word the same.
compare.tooLong: One of these is too long to compare word by word. Both are shown in full.

add.title: Add a document
add.subtitle: Read your own act, manual or office order here, with the same highlights and notes. It stays on this device.
add.noTextLayer: This PDF has no text in it — it is a scan of a page. This app does not read scans, so there is nothing to extract. A PDF that you can select text in will work.
add.unsupported: This app can read .txt, .md, .pdf and .docx files.
add.tooBig: That file is larger than {{mb}} MB. Paste the part you need instead.
add.failed: That file could not be read on this device.
add.notePlaceholder: A note to yourself — who issued it, and when.
add.unitWordLabel: One part of this document is a…
add.reviewSubtitle: The raw text is on the left and the parts this app found are on the right. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

notes.preamble: The text before the first numbered part is kept as part 0. Delete it or retitle it if it is a heading.
notes.low-confidence: Some parts were found from a bare number with no heading. Check those.
notes.inline: This document has no line breaks, so the parts were found from the numbering inside one paragraph. Check them carefully.
notes.unstructured: No numbering could be found, so the whole document is one part. You can split it below.

add.saved: Saved. It is on your shelf now.
add.notOfficial: Your own document — not an official dataset, and not checked by this app.
add.importFailed: That file is not a document exported from this app.
add.deleteWorkConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” and everything you highlighted or wrote on it? This cannot be undone.
add.mineNone: You have not added any documents yet.
